title: Countable open cover with Lipschitz pieces for a map locally Lipschitz on an arbitrary set (parent step 1)
statement: For all P, Q ∈ ℕ, every set U ⊆ ℝ^P and every map f : ℝ^P → ℝ^Q that is locally Lipschitz on U, there are open sets O_i ⊆ ℝ^P and constants K_i ∈ ℝ≥0 (i ∈ ℕ) such that U ⊆ ⋃_i O_i and f is K_i-Lipschitz on O_i ∩ U for every i. Here 'locally Lipschitz on U' means: every x ∈ U has a neighbourhood t within U (t ∈ 𝓝[U] x) and a constant K ≥ 0 such that f is K-Lipschitz on t.
lean_statement: ∀ (P Q : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q), LocallyLipschitzOn U f → ∃ (O : ℕ → Set (Eucl P)) (K : ℕ → ℝ≥0), (∀ i, IsOpen (O i)) ∧ U ⊆ ⋃ i, O i ∧ ∀ i, LipschitzOnWith (K i) f (O i ∩ U)
